mapper.select: SELECT FROM marketing_task_export_job WHERE created_by=#{createdBy} AND request_hash=#{requestHash} AND export_mode IN ('ATTRIBUTION','VISIT_TREND') AND status IN ('PENDING','PROCESSING') ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM marketing_task_export_job WHERE export_mode IN ('ATTRIBUTION','VISIT_TREND') AND attempt_count<3 AND (status='PENDING' OR (status='PROCESSING' AND lease_until<#{now})) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE marketing_task_export_job SET status='FAILED',error_message=#{errorMessage}, lease_until=NULL,claim_token=NULL,finished_at=#{now},updated_at=#{now} WHERE export_mode IN ('ATTRIBUTION','VISIT_TREND') AND status='PROCESSING' AND lease_until<#{now} AND attempt_count>=3

UPDATE marketing_task_export_job SET status='PROCESSING',claim_token=#{claimToken}, lease_until=#{leaseUntil},attempt_count=attempt_count+1,error_message=NULL,updated_at=#{now} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND export_mode IN ('ATTRIBUTION','VISIT_TREND') AND attempt_count<3 AND (status='PENDING' OR (status='PROCESSING' AND lease_until<#{now}))
